summary.en: Terminal AI coding assistant from OSCHINA (開源中國) shipped as a single binary, with a windows-arm64 zip.
summary.zh-TW: 開源中國（OSCHINA）的終端機 AI 程式助理，單一執行檔，提供 windows-arm64 壓縮檔。

caveats.en: Source covers Windows on Arm in general; RTX Spark was not tested.
caveats.zh-TW: 來源涵蓋一般 Windows on Arm，未針對 RTX Spark 測試。
